findings.finding: Rung comment drift: several rungs explain implementation mechanics or justify structural choices instead of naming the physical action/destination — rung 3 ("One rung, one branch per entry path: cycle loop back from 55, idle ready, and the empty init exit posture..."), rung 6 ("Mid flight band detection, with the parallel strict arrival branch for a short resume stroke..."), rung 8 ("Second branch is the part in hand resume..."), rung 12, rung 20, and the same habit in R04 rungs 15/16/22 and R05 rungs 14/15/16. Trim to the template's terse action naming; the state map in rung 0 already carries the narrative.
findings.templateEvidence: S05 R02 comments are terse action names ("State 7: Extend z axis to pick position", "State 16: Extend x axis (Application dependent - add wideband positioning permissive...)"); Jason 2026-08-25: comments name the physical action or destination, never segment mechanics or justifications.

findings.finding: Rung 2 seeds ZAxisSafePosition as Retract + Positions[6] (PlaceRetractBlend) only. The ruling is Retract + the LARGER of the two corner blends; today both rows are 25 mm so it happens to match, but if the ME raises PickRetractBlend the permissive band becomes too tight and the pick-side corner blend gets quickstopped mid-traverse. Seed from the larger of Positions[5]/Positions[6] (a GT-selected branch or CPT) instead of hard-picking one row, and drop the "adjust in Studio if they diverge" caveat from the comment.
findings.templateEvidence: Jason Perry ruling 2026-08-25 (servo-motion.md, X-traverse permissive): "seed it at first scan (S:FS) from Retract plus the larger corner blend"; every sanctioned overlap window must be inside the safe zone by construction.

findings.finding: Rung 4's quickstop reason uses XIO(XAxisPermissive) rather than the explicit complement of the permissive compare. It therefore also reports the Z-position reason when the real cause is Z not homed. Use GT(HMI_ZAxis.Status.ActualPosition, ZAxisSafePosition) as the reason branch so the message is the exact complement of the compare that dropped the permissive.
findings.templateEvidence: S05 R20 rung 4 conditions the reason string on the specific position condition (XIO(ZAxisRetract.InPos) XIO(ZAxisRetract.InPosWide)); Jason 2026-08-25: "R20's quickstop reason is the exact complement of the same compare."

findings.finding: Rungs 11/12 fold the MAM-command states (7/19 and 31/43) into the "...To Reach Pick/Place Speed Transition" alarms. Those states exit on ZAxis_MAM.IP — a timeout there means the move never STARTED, and the operator gets a message naming a milestone the axis was not yet waiting on. Coverage and FaultTime bookkeeping are otherwise clean (no state appears in two rungs). Filed as a standards question rather than a fix because the templates predate the three-state MCD stroke and do not show how the alarms partition.
findings.templateEvidence: S05 R20 rungs 5–9: one rung per wait, message names the destination the state is actually waiting on ("Waiting For Z Axis To Extend To Pick"), each owning its own MOVE(n,Control.FaultTime).

findings.finding: Rungs 6 and 7 replace the template's \S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete gate with XIC(g_MachineBasic.AlwaysOff) plus a *Replace comment, and rung 7 ORs in the standalone XIC(Status.State[55]) completion branch. Correct for the standalone proving scope and correctly commented — recorded so the two stubs are re-pointed at integration, not as a finding.
findings.templateEvidence: S05 R03 rungs 6/7 gate on \S00_IndexerSP.q_WaitStationsComplete; template idiom for unbuilt conditions is an AlwaysOff placeholder with a *Replace comment (R02 rung 18, R01 rung 5).

findings.finding: Rung 22's XAxisPlace RangeCheck takes its wide band by direct reference to HMI_ZAxis.Parameters.Positions[6] (PlaceRetractBlend). This is declared as a PROPOSED NON-STANDARD PATTERN both in the approved sequence's Template conformance block and in the rung comment, so it is not a silent invention; it is the subject of the standards question below.
findings.templateEvidence: S05 R04 rung 21 uses a literal wide band (5); Jason's corrected file shows per-corner instances on the axis that OWNS the blend row — no template shows the corner's other (cross-axis) leg.

internalReview.summary: Structurally this is a clean piece of surgery: R02 sequence rungs run 4→55 strictly ascending ahead of the full override block, one MAM per axis with a plain state-list auto branch, the grouped multi-profile Z staging rung plus the single MCD rung with its own control/staging tags, per-position RangeCheck instances including one per corner, both init postures and both resume branches intact, EQ/NE/LT/GE family throughout — none of the old failure classes appear. Two real red-pen items: several R02/R04/R05 rung comments justify implementation choices instead of naming the action, and the ZAxisSafePosition seed hard-picks the place-side blend instead of the LARGER of the two blend rows (works only because both are 25 mm today). I am holding rather than shipping on two genuine standards unknowns the templates don't answer: the cross-axis corner-blend wide band (you declared it as a proposed non-standard pattern — good) and how R20 alarms partition across the three states of an MCD stroke. Get those two answers back and this ships with the comment trim and the safe-position seed fix.

writingNotes.text: Translation of the approved S01 ServoPNP sequence onto the S05 template. Two divergences are declared rather than taken silently: (1) each transition-band wait exit (states 10/22/34/46) carries the mandatory parallel strict-final-arrival branch per Jason's 2026-08-25 ruling (a resume stroke can start beyond the band) - declared in structuralChanges with an irPatch; (2) the X-traverse permissive is implemented as Jason's Teams ruling - XIC(iq_ZAxis.AxisHomedStatus) LE(HMI_ZAxis.Status.ActualPosition,ZAxisSafePosition) - which explicitly supersedes the build's earlier parked-band/blend-bit enumeration flag. ZAxisSafePosition is seeded at first scan from Retract + the place-side corner blend row (both corner blends are 25 mm; adjust in Studio if they diverge). Z increases downward (Retract 5, Pick 60, Place 80) so at/above safe is LE, and the R20 quickstop reason is the exact complement XIO(XAxisPermissive). Z position slots: [0]=Retract [1]=PickTransition [2]=Pick [3]=PlaceTransition [4]=Place [5]=PickRetractBlend [6]=PlaceRetractBlend. X slots: [0]=Pick [1]=Place; the XAxisPlace wide band references HMI_ZAxis.Parameters.Positions[6] (the ME's single place-corner value) as flagged. No gripper alarms (sensorless timer-only gripper).

structuralChanges.text: Each transition-band wait exit (10->13, 22->25, 34->37, 46->49) gained a parallel strict final-arrival branch alongside the bare InPosWide test, because a resume/recovery stroke can start beyond the band and a band-only exit would then never fire (Jason Perry ruling, 2026-08-25).
